decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship tied to the firm's sustainability direction, management stays heavily committed and would likely blame its two years off the website on seasonal and pandemic-related adoption delays.
The stackable crate line fits the core reusable packaging portfolio and carries sunk mold investments, so persistence is likely despite its disappearance from the website.
The line was visibly committed with its own page and several models, but it is peripheral to transport packaging and has not been shown for two years, so it is kept only narrowly.
A single, non-central pallet variant missing from the website since 2020 offers little to justify further commitment, and the firm has already shown in 2019 that it will drop pallet products.
